inspection_advice: Inspect EGR valve and inlet conduit for carbon/soot buildup and check for related fault codes, especially on higher mileage vehicles.

inspection_advice: Test drive to assess gear shift smoothness. Test reverse gear engagement multiple times.

label: DPF clogging from short trips
symptom: Frequent regeneration requests, loss of power, or DPF warning light illumination.
cause: Insufficient exhaust temperatures during short trips preventing regeneration.
fix: Forced regeneration or replacement of DPF.
inspection_advice: Check DPF condition and regeneration history via diagnostic scan.
